gloss: on the contrary; rather; all the more

definitions.gloss: on the contrary; rather; all the more
definitions.explanation: Used when the result is opposite of what was expected, or when something intensifies rather than lessens.

examples.japanese: {却|かえ}って⟦{悪|わる}く→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧⟦{方|ほう}→〜方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{却|かえ}って⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧。
⟦{休|やす}んだ→休む：00606_yasumu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{却|かえ}って⟦{疲|つか}れた→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧。
examples.english: Even though I rested, I ended up more tired.

examples.japanese: ⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦したら→する：00392_suru⟧{却|かえ}って⟦{混乱|こんらん}→混乱：02811_konran⟧⟦させて→する：00392_suru⟧⟦しまった→しまう：03064_shimau⟧。
examples.english: When I tried to explain, I ended up confusing them even more.

examples.japanese: ⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦もの→物：02259_mono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}ったら→買う：00489_kau⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦{壊|こわ}れて→壊れる：00791_kowareru⟧{却|かえ}って⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦ついた→付く：01960_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: I bought the cheap one, but it broke right away and ended up costing me more.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
{却|かえ}って is used when:
1. An action produces the opposite of its intended effect
2. Something unexpected happens that goes against common sense
3. A simpler or different approach turns out better
- 〜⟦したら→する：00392_suru⟧{却|かえ}って〜: when I did ~, it actually ~
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方|ほう}→〜方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{却|かえ}って〜: actually, ~ is more ~
- {却|かえ}って⟦{悪|わる}く→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become worse instead

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦むしろ→むしろ：02364_mushiro⟧: rather (neutral comparison)
- ⟦{逆|ぎゃく}→逆：02649_gyaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: on the contrary
